experiment.description: Read-only comparison of the local and the Hugging Face hosted query embedding over the frozen 96-query mein-konto v1 development dataset, under the unchanged production retrieval contract.

retrievalConfiguration.rankingOrder: score DESC, document_key ASC, document_version ASC, chunk_key ASC

classificationDefinitions.accepted: at least one of the returned maxChunks scores >= 0.80
classificationDefinitions.correctAccept: answerable and an accepted chunk fully covers the labelled evidence
classificationDefinitions.wrongAccept: answerable, accepted, but no accepted chunk covers the labelled evidence
classificationDefinitions.topOneCorrect: rank-1 chunk equals the chunk fully covering the expected evidence

notes: labelled Top-1 changed on 3 query/queries with no net loss (2 resolved, 1 regressed)
9 query/queries where the returned Top-3 chunk set differs
6 query/queries where the Top-3 order differs with the same chunks
the served remote revision is unpinnable (no X-Repo-Commit header) — an accepted limitation carried from Gate 3
remote latency is roughly an order of magnitude above the local arm and is measured from this machine, not from the deployment target
